notes: All key claims verified. (1) Issue 33 body verbatim: 'rqt_plot API has been changed by this commit. https://github.com/ros-visualization/rqt_common_plugins/commit/f7a485e0...' plus the full traceback ending 'AttributeError: 'FullSizeDataPlot' object has no attribute 'autoscroll'' (failed conditions #0 and #1 quotes verbatim). (2) Provider refactor commit f7a485e0 'Refactor graph backends into wrapper' (2014-05-23). (3) Fix commits: 5ee65b06 'now it uses dataplot class instead of mat dataplot...', 6df4bd7e 'uses dataplot', 55e84a61 'now it uses Rqt DataPlot instead our own version' (the spec's resolved_rev). (4) Resolution comment 51742356 (jihoonl, 2014-08-11) 'Battery profiling now has fixed y scale [0, 180]. and gyro looks fine too.' (5) E2 library-API eligible at step 6: rqt_plot (separately released, /opt/ros/indigo) and kobuki_qtestsuite (rqt plugin) are separate units; PlotWidget.switch_data_plot_widget requires the handed-in widget to provide autoscroll(), which MatDataPlot provided at 0.3.3-0.3.6 and no longer provides after the refactor. (6) Two conditions both element_removed_or_renamed: the autoscroll method was stripped from the backend MatDataPlot (c8223f54 in the same series; DataPlot.autoscroll replaces it), and the module was moved from rqt_plot.mat_data_plot to rqt_plot.data_plot.mat_data_plot (f7a485e0), so 'from rqt_plot.mat_data_plot import MatDataPlot' has no target in a clean 0.3.7+ install. Implicated elements correct. The spec correctly notes the observed crash is the autoscroll AttributeError (the import evidently resolved in the reporter's run, unexplained — likely a stale compiled module), while the module move is the reporter's named API change. (7) Loudness loud_documented + activate: 'PluginManager._load_plugin() could not load plugin ...' is the rqt plugin manager's activation-time diagnostic, raised before any plotting. (8) Resolution 'observed': the maintainer reports the fixed battery/gyro display working after 55e84a61. No missed conditions.
